name: Kashish Attar 3ml
description: Kashish is a luxury, musk-infused eau de parfum crafted for modern, successful men. Designed by master perfumers using premium ingredients, it offers an alluring, long-lasting scent that blends sophistication with charisma. Versatile enough for both formal wear and casual outings, this iconic fragrance delivers an unforgettable olfactory experience and leaves a lasting impression of exclusivity and success.

name: Chocolate Attar 3ml
description: Indulge in the decadent blend of white musk, rich cocoa, and sweet vanilla. Chocolate Musk Attar offers a warm, captivating, and long-lasting unisex fragrance that elevates your presence with effortless elegance and charm.

name: Aseel Attar 3ml
description: Experience timeless luxury with Aseel Attar. A refined, woody blend combining delicate florals like rose and jasmine with warm spices and deep musky notes, crafted for men and women who appreciate sophisticated elegance.

name: Anam Attar 3ml
description: Unveil pure grace with Anam Attar. Featuring a beautiful harmony of soft rose, jasmine, and rich sandalwood, this alcohol-free, long-lasting floral fragrance is designed for confident women who embody natural beauty and sophistication.

name: Baqoor Attar 3ml
description: Step into pure opulence with Baqoor Attar. A rich Middle Eastern blend featuring pure oud wood, warm ambergris, sandalwood, and exotic hints of saffron and cinnamon. Intense, long-lasting, and deeply aromatic, it’s an unforgettable scent for lovers of luxury.

name: Faraaz Attar 3ml
description: Crafted for the modern man who values tradition and prestige, Faraaz is an intense, long-lasting Arabian attar oil. It opens with an invigorating burst of citrus and floral jasmine before evolving into a rich, masculine base of patchouli, cedarwood, and deep oud accents. Free from fast-evaporating alcohol, this scent develops beautifully on the skin over time, leaving a lasting impression wherever you go.

name: Jannat Ul Firdaus Attar 3ml
description: Transport yourself to paradise with Jannat-ul Firdaus. Crafted for the modern man, this wild, long-lasting attar blends rich oud and sensual musk to create an intoxicating, unforgettable aroma. Perfect for making a bold statement anywhere you go.

name: Kala Gulab Attar 3ml
description: Elevate your daily routine with Kala Gulab. A harmonious blend of delicate rose petals and subtle undertones, this natural, long-lasting attar inspires optimism and effortless sophistication for both men and women.

name: Lexus Attar 3ml
description: Experience serious luxury with Lexus Attar. A masterful blend of deep oud arabia, warm spices, gentle florals, and a rich touch of amber and musk. Non-alcoholic and long-lasting, it exudes an expensive, graceful aura for any special occasion.

name: Motia Attar 3ml
description: Unwind with the pure, calming essence of Motia Attar. Capturing the authentic, clean aroma of natural jasmine, this soothing attar adds a touch of timeless luxury and serenity to your daily personal routine or living space.

name: Danish Attar 3ml
description: Immerse yourself in Arabian opulence with Danish. A sophisticated men's attar featuring rich oud arabia, refined musk, and smooth sandalwood. Long-lasting and mysterious, it is the ultimate signature scent for the discerning gentleman.

name: Hina Attar 3ml
description: Discover power and poise with Hina Attar. A mesmerizing blend of earthy hina, deep musk, warm amber, and sandalwood. This bold, non-alcoholic oriental fragrance brings a touch of mysterious strength to the modern woman.

name: Arsh Attar 3ml
description: Embody royal elegance with Arsh Attar. A refreshing burst of citrus and lemon transitions into a warm heart of rose and spice, grounded by sensual amber and musk. Alcohol-free, long-lasting, and conveniently packaged in a roll-on bottle for on-the-go luxury.

name: Gulab Attar 3ml
description: Experience timeless floral luxury with Gulab Attar. A seamless fusion of French elegance and Arabian warmth, this non-alcoholic rose attar features a rich base of sandalwood, oud, and amber. Pure, long-lasting, and designed for men and women of sophistication.

name: Mushk Attar 3ml
description: Experience the raw, powerful allure of Mushk Attar. Featuring a bold, traditional, and long-lasting musk profile, this intense fragrance delivers an unforgettable olfactory journey for men and women who love authentic, standout scents.

name: Poison Attar 3ml
description: Embody pure opulence with Poison Attar. A magnificent blend of old-world charm and contemporary style, this luxurious scent fuses rich oud attar notes with deep eau de parfum elegance for a truly unforgettable aromatic experience.

name: Shadow Attar 3ml
description: Make a statement with Shadow Attar. Combining traditional attar craftsmanship with modern style, this rich blend of oud and eau de parfum delivers a long-lasting, sophisticated scent that exudes class and uniqueness.

name: Peace Attar 3ml
description: Inspire tranquility and serenity with Peace Attar. A soothing, long-lasting daily fragrance featuring delicate floral notes with a persistent, timeless appeal. Perfect for both men and women seeking a calming touch of elegance.

name: Shah Jahan Attar 3ml
description: Step into royal heritage with Shah Jahan Attar. Crafted for the modern man, this classic arabic scent fuses the fullness of oud arabia with rich eau de parfum depth, creating a timeless, seductive, and long-lasting signature fragrance.

name: Zeba Attar 3ml
description: Capture the calm and cozy essence of breezy evenings with Zeba Attar. Combining fresh, gentle, and soothing notes, this natural fragrance adds a touch of tranquil elegance and warmth to your daily routine.
